title: Take the People Out: Build Your Org Chart Right
description:
Most owners think an org chart is for big companies. It isn't. This is the exercise that gets your business out of your head.
https://allthepower.co.uk

Even if it is just you right now, you already have an org chart. You are sitting in every seat: sales, marketing, operations, accounts. And while all of it lives in your head, nobody else can touch it, so you cannot grow, step back, or take a proper holiday.

This lesson walks you through building your chart the right way. You take the people out first and map what the business actually needs, you forward-pace to the business running well, you put a real time cost against every task, and you learn the test for the right person in the right seat: they get it, they want it, and they have the capacity. Then you give every seat an SOP so the work can finally leave your head.

This is a Thrive Business Community exercise. Take it away and build your own.
